questions.heading: The Change Folder: Proposal, Delta, Design and Tasks
questions.stem: Coast must get at least 30% of each year's spend. One year the plan spends $2,000k, $600k of it on Coast. Which row does the design's form give, and is the year kept?

options.text: spend_coast >= 0.3 spend: 600 >= 600, so it is kept
options.says: The design multiplies by 100 so every coefficient is an integer, as CP-SAT asks.
Equal sides keep the row: a plan exactly at the share is allowed.
Right: the multiplied-out row, met exactly at the boundary.

options.text: spend_coast / spend >= 30: a ratio of 0.3, so refused
options.says: The design: a ratio of two spends is not linear, so it is multiplied out.

questions.heading: What the Share Costs, and What the Planners Should See
questions.stem: A region has a 25% share, and none of its projects may start in 2029. What does the model allow in 2029?

options.text: No spend at all, the only 2029 that keeps the share
options.says: Right: as in 2027 on the page, the only year that keeps it is an empty one.

options.text: Any spend, since the share skips a year with no such project
options.says: The page: 2027 spent nothing because no Plains project could start.

options.text: No plan at all, since the whole model becomes infeasible
options.says: The page's plan was OPTIMAL, with 2027 empty.

options.text: Spend up to 25% of the budget, the share's own limit
options.says: The share is of what the plan spends, not of the budget.

questions.heading: Tests First: Six Scenarios, Six Tests, Six Failures on the Old Code
questions.stem: A test of a share rule checks only that a plan with the region exactly at its share is allowed. Why does the page call that too weak?

options.text: It is strong enough, since it sits exactly on the boundary
options.says: The page: a test with only the allowed plan is too weak, even one sitting exactly on the boundary.

options.text: It fails on the old code, so it cannot test the new rule
options.says: The page: on the old code the allowed half passed.

options.text: The share row refuses it, since exactly 25% is not enough
options.says: The page: a plan exactly at the share is allowed.

options.text: A model with no share rule at all would also pass it
options.says: Right: a model with no rule allows everything.
